Exact variance identity normalizes to B(q), polynomial of degree at most r−1 with coefficient b_j=Σ_{s≥r−j}N_s; adjacent differences invert. Exact Fractions verifier exhaustively checks 10,968 weighted configurations, 27 moment comparisons and nine independent cubic-coefficient calculations; the analytic proof handles all finite regular graphs.

value.rationale: Independent habitat-loss sampling supplies a natural observable (variance of the number of isolated surviving habitat patches), while the mean depends only on known n and r and cannot reveal adjacency. The variance can recover the complete shared-neighbor histogram and triangle count using finitely many retention levels, and the C10 versus two C5 witness proves exactly where the inverse information stops. This is an interpretable structural inverse invariant rather than arbitrary small-case census.
